title: CI Path Filter (바뀐 경로에 따라 필요한 CI Job만 실행)

command: import yaml; d=yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml',encoding='utf-8')); j=d['jobs']; assert {'changes','frontend','backend'} <= set(j), 'jobs'; assert all('changes' in (j[k].get('needs') if isinstance(j[k].get('needs'),list) else [j[k].get('needs')]) and 'needs.changes.outputs.'+k in str(j[k].get('if','')) for k in ('frontend','backend')), 'needs/if'
